description: End a Poppy Session. Rove removes the site's cookies and saved data from this browser before the site is used without Poppy again (poppy_status shows cleanup done). With sign_out: true it also deletes the person's stored approval for the site and revokes it there.

session_id.description: Supervised session ID. Defaults to this connection's active session.

sign_out.description: Also delete and revoke the stored approval, so the next connection to the site starts signed out.

name: poppy_disconnect
title: Disconnect a Poppy site
